title: Function parameter validation runtime guidelines — single-pass validation, streaming errors, and backward-compatible schema shim
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Define a compact JSON-schema convention and runtime contract for function/tool parameters that supports single-pass validation, streaming validation feedback (for large/streamed inputs), and a compatibility shim for older schema versions. Key ideas: 1) Provide a constrained subset of JSON Schema (type, required, enum, pattern, min/max, items) plus runtime annotations: "x-fc-name" (stable canonical name), "x-fc-version" (schema version), "x-fc-deprecation" (fallback guidance). 2) Runtime emits structured error frames when validation fails; each frame is machine-readable with fields (error_code, field_path, phase, message, suggestion). Proposed error codes: FC100 (missing_required), FC200 (type_mismatch), FC300 (constraint_violation), FC400 (unknown_parameter), FC500 (partial_validation), FC600 (deprecated_field), FC900 (compatibility_fallback). 3) Streaming: validator runs incrementally for large array/string inputs and emits FC500 frames for partial failures with a recommended action (continue, truncate, reject). 4) Compatibility shim: when encountering an older schema version, runtime attempts a deterministic coaxing pass: field name mapping, relaxed-type coercions (string->number when safe), and fallback to a compatible model variant. The shim logs a compatibility_fallback error (FC900) and attaches the applied transforms. 5) Error semantics: distinguish hard errors that cause 400/422 vs warnings surfaced in response body but allowed at runtime. 6) UX: errors surfaced to callers include canonical code, user-facing summary, developer hint, and a pointer to a diagnostic trace id for deeper logs. Implementation notes: small, permissive schema subset minimizes runtime cost; keep schema size < 8KB recommended; use streaming validators for arrays to preserve low latency. This ticket covers spec doc + reference implementation in runtime and tests.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Spec doc merged in docs repo outlining schema subset, annotations, and error codes. 2) Runtime prototype validating parameters against spec and emitting structured error frames in streaming mode. 3) Compatibility shim implemented with unit tests covering mapping/coercions. 4) Backwards compatibility test cases for 3 prior schema versions. 5) Two integration smoke tests showing client-visible error codes and HTTP status mappings.
comments: 2025-02-16 - PM review (Sophie Müller): asked that we include explicit guidance for user-visible vs developer-only errors; decided to add 'phase' values: precheck, full, postprocess.
2025-02-20 - Eng sync: agreed on compact schema subset and 'x-fc-*' annotations. Trade-off: fewer schema features reduces expressivity but improves runtime performance and determinism.

2025-02-24 - Prototype: streaming validator emits FC500 frames during array ingestion; observed ~6% latency overhead in synthetic benchmark. Action: optimize by early-shortcircuiting on required-field failures.
2025-02-27 - Security review (Alex Torres): recommended logging transforms performed by compatibility shim to audit trail; no blocking issues.
2025-03-01 - Design feedback (Priya Rao): suggested clearer error messaging for end-users; added 'user_message' and 'dev_hint' fields to error frames.
2025-03-02 - Ready for implementation handoff: engineering owner will open runtime PRs and assign e2e test to QA.
